meta.title: Rejected Bids is offered on an upcoming RFQ
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ rather than creating or searching for an event.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Verify Rejected Bids is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Rejected Bids to open its window without confirming any change.
Assert that the Rejected Bids window opened.
Cancel the window so no rejection action is applied.
Verify the Rejected Bids window closed after cancellation.
